display.purpose: One per view: the page title.

title.purpose: Panel titles; small and quiet so content outranks the label.

body.purpose: All reading text and table cells; density is the point.

label.purpose: Field labels, table headers, side labels. The 11px floor.

data-mono.purpose: Hashes, purls, license text. Never a costume.

shadows.name: sh-1 resting
shadows.purpose: Panels, stat tiles, primary buttons. A one-pixel whisper; dark theme uses 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,.4).

shadows.name: sh-2 floating
shadows.purpose: Modals and toasts only - the things above the page plane. Dark theme uses 0 16px 36px rgba(0,0,0,.55).

shadows.name: focus halo
shadows.purpose: Focus ring on inputs and selects; state, not elevation.

motion.name: dur
motion.purpose: Routine state change: hover, focus, selection.

motion.name: ease
motion.purpose: Single easing curve for every transition in the system.

motion.name: press
motion.purpose: The only place a control moves; removed under reduced motion.

motion.name: progress-slide
motion.purpose: Indeterminate bar; runs ONLY while body.busy. Zero animations at rest.

motion.name: reduced-motion policy
motion.value: travel removed; colour and opacity transitions kept (120-160ms)
motion.purpose: Toast, modal, hover and selection feedback stay legible; the progress bar becomes a static full-width bar.

breakpoints.name: layout
breakpoints.purpose: Desk collapses to one column; sidebar stacks above content.

breakpoints.name: cards
breakpoints.purpose: Tables become label/value cards; no horizontal scroll on phones.

breakpoints.name: coarse
breakpoints.purpose: Input method, not width: controls lift to 40px.

themes.name: dark
themes.purpose: A working theme, not an inversion. Every token has a twin; AA measured in both.

narrative.overview: This interface is a desk where two documents about the same component are laid side by side - the project list's declared license data and the scanner's observed data - and a human decides which one is right. Everything on screen exists to make that comparison fast, legible, and attributable. The system runs dense and small on purpose: a reviewer triages hundreds of components per session. Dark mode is a working theme, not a night mode.
keyCharacteristics: Two sources, one screen: the scanner side is accented, the project-list side is neutral.
Verdict colours appear only on verdict-bearing text and badges, and only when the count is non-zero.
Flat surfaces, hairline borders, two shadows total. Depth is a response to state.
Small type, tabular numerals, no orphaned empty values.
Motion is feedback only. Nothing moves while the page is at rest.

rules.name: The Two-Source Rule
rules.body: Colour encodes provenance. The scanner side takes Review Blue; the project-list side takes Ink Secondary. A third hue never stands in for either side.

rules.name: The Verdict Hue Rule
rules.body: Green, amber, and red appear only on text or badges that report a judgement, and a zero count is never painted in a verdict hue.

rules.name: The Measured Pair Rule
rules.body: Every colour token has a dark twin, and both are held to WCAG AA against their own background.

rules.name: The Small-Type Floor
rules.body: 11px is the smallest type in the system. If something needs to be smaller, it needs to be a different design.

rules.name: The Tabular Rule
rules.body: Any numeral a reviewer compares down a column is tabular.

rules.name: The Content-Driven Grid Rule
rules.body: Grids break at their content's minimum readable width, not at device widths.

rules.name: The Card-on-Narrow Rule
rules.body: Below 640px a table is a stack of cards. A phone never scrolls sideways to read a component.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest. Hover changes colour, never height.

rules.name: The One Primary Rule
rules.body: One primary button per view. Everything else is secondary, tiny, or danger.

rules.name: The Named Action Rule
rules.body: A control states its consequence, and a destructive control says so in words before it is pressed.

dos: Do keep the type scale at 13px body / 11px label, and never go below 11px.
Do add a dark twin for every new colour token and measure both against their own background before shipping.
Do reserve Review Blue for scanner-side, active, and focus.
Do use the verdict washes for badges and verdict text only, and leave zero counts neutral.
Do reach for the spacing scale via .mt-2/.mt-3 or panel rhythm - never an inline style attribute.
Do keep the empty state a single em-dash token so 'no data' looks identical everywhere.
Do keep every interactive control at 24px minimum, and expect 40px under pointer: coarse.
Do use the modal for any prompt or confirmation.
Do gate any looping animation to a real in-flight state.
donts: Don't add a coloured left border to a new card, callout, or alert; the 3px provenance tab is a data encoding.
Don't use transition: all or will-change. Both are at zero occurrences; keep them there.
Don't animate anything at rest, and don't animate layout properties.
Don't hard-code colours. Three literals remain grandfathered; new work adds none.
Don't reduce motion by killing all motion. Travel goes; colour and opacity feedback stays.
Don't paint a stat red or amber when its value is zero.
Don't let a table force the page to scroll horizontally.
